comment: C ref: save.c savegamestate():306-307 and restore.c restgamestate():671-672, the gm.migrating_objs and gm.migrating_mons chains. Segment 1 creates the Wizard of Yendor in debug mode and level-teleports away; dog.c keepdogs() puts the Wizard on gm.migrating_mons for his own level (MIGR_EXACT_XY), and the game is saved. Segment 2 restores and level-teleports back, where dog.c losedogs() must find him. Seed, clock and character chosen independently.
